    Liquidity on KTC

    Using the latest 25,000 real trades in our Dynasty Trade Database, we determine a 'Liquidity Score' for every player that represents how frequently they appear in trades compared to other players.

    Liquidity Scores are standardized across all players. The player that appeared in the most trades (the most liquid) has a score of 99, a player that appeared half as frequently would be at 50, and a player that hadn't appeared hardly at all would be at 1.

    Learn more about Liquidity in our FAQs here.
